_comment: Stable hooks scripts/hook-coverage.py doesn't expect a demo site to render. Every entry needs a reason; `match` is an fnmatch pattern; `transient` marks states that only sometimes get caught, so rendering them isn't worth a note. Re-check the 'not emitted' entries when core changes: hook-coverage.py notes allowlisted hooks that do render.
